director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
haan, samajh aaya

Socho, chaar log ek roti barabar baantein. Yeh roti 4 barabar hisson mein bati hai, aur rang wala hissa 1/4 hai. Barabar hisson mein se aisa ek hissa fractional unit kehlata hai. Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: 1/4 sahi nahi hai. Aath dost yeh roti barabar baantein, toh har dost ko ek hissa milta hai; us hisse ka naam doston ki ginti se banta hai, pehli roti ke 4 se nahi. 8 barabar hisson wali roti ka ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: 1/8 hissa

Haan, bilkul theek. Roti ke 8 barabar hisse, aur yeh unmein se ek. Do pattiyan dekho, dono ke 3 hisse. A ke teeno hisse barabar hain, toh har hissa 1/3 hai. B ke hisse chhote-bade hain, toh unhe gin kar 1/3 nahi keh sakte. Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?
director.card: Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?

director.text: teeno

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain. Dono pattiyon ke teen hisse, par barabar sirf pehli ke. Hisse gin kar 1/3 jaisa naam tabhi dete hain, jab patti ke saare hisse barabar hon. 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

seams.form: Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain.

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 1

Sahi jawab, kyunki 24 ka 1/3, yaani 24 ÷ 3 = 8 cm; ribbon mein 8 cm ka hissa sirf 1 hai. Chalo, pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain. 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hisson wali 15 cm ki patti mein, kaunsa hissa 1/3 hai?
director.card: Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?

seams.form: Chalo, pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain.

director.text: paanch wala

Haan, sahi hai. Patti ke teen barabar hisse 5-5 cm ke hote. Ab do ribbon lo: P 20 cm ki, Q 12 cm ki. P ka 1/2 10 cm hai, aur Q ka 1/2 6 cm. Naam ek hai, 1/2, par poora alag hai, isliye lambai alag hai. Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?
director.card: Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?

director.text: 2 cm zyada

Bilkul sahi: P ka 1/4 5 cm, Q ka sirf 3 cm. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain. Dadi ne 30 cm lamba ganna barabar hisson mein kaata, aur har hissa 6 cm ka hai. Ab dekhna hai ki ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai. Ganna kitne barabar hisson mein bata, yeh kis hisaab se nikaaloge?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain.

director.text: 27 ko 6 se bhaag

Nahi, yeh nahi hai. Hisson ki ginti ke liye 30 ko 6 se bhaag denge, kyunki dekhna hai ki 30 cm mein 6 cm kitni baar aata hai. Dhyaan rakhna, fractional unit ke neeche hisse ki lambai 6 nahi aati; neeche woh ginti aati hai ki ganna kitne barabar hisson mein bata. Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: 1/6 sahi nahi hai. 6 toh ek hisse ki lambai hai, hisson ki ginti nahi; gino ki 30 cm mein 6 cm wale kitne hisse aate hain. 30 cm ke ganne ka 6 cm wala ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: ek-paanchvaan

Haan, bilkul theek. 30 ÷ 6 = 5, toh neeche 5 aata hai, 6 nahi. Toh poora jawab: ek hissa poore ganne ka 1/5 hai. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 2, 6 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?
director.card: 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 2, 6 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?

director.text: ek bhi hissa nahi

Sahi jawab, kyunki 16 ÷ 4 = 4, toh 1/4 hissa 4 cm ka hota; yahan koi hissa 4 cm ka nahi, toh 0 hisse. Ek ribbon 60 cm ki hai aur doosri 30 cm ki. Rahul ne pehli ka 1/3 liya, aur Sana ne doosri ka 1/2. Dono ke hisson mein kitne cm ka fark hai?
director.card: Ek ribbon 60 cm ki hai aur doosri 30 cm ki. Rahul ne pehli ka 1/3 liya, aur Sana ne doosri ka 1/2. Dono ke hisson mein kitne cm ka fark hai?

director.text: samajh nahi aaya

Dono hisson ki lambai alag-alag nikalo: pehle pehli ribbon ka 1/3, phir doosri ribbon ka 1/2. Phir dono lambaiyon ka fark dekho. 60 cm ki ribbon ka 1/3 aur 30 cm ki ribbon ka 1/2: in dono mein kitne cm ka fark hai?
director.card: Ek ribbon 60 cm ki hai aur doosri 30 cm ki. Rahul ne pehli ka 1/3 liya, aur Sana ne doosri ka 1/2. Dono ke hisson mein kitne cm ka fark hai?

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yahan dono ribbon ek hi scale par hain: Sana wali 30 cm par khatam hoti hai, Rahul wali 60 cm par. Ab tum batao.

director.text: 10 sahi nahi hai. Isko ek naye dhang se dekhein. 30 cm ki ribbon ka aadha 15 cm hai, 10 cm wali ka 5 cm. Dono aadhe hain, par 15 cm wala lambi ribbon ka hai. Laal ribbon 36 cm ki, neeli 24 cm ki. Laal ka 1/3 aur neeli ka 1/2: kiska hissa lamba hai, ya dono barabar?
director.card: Laal ribbon 36 cm ki, neeli 24 cm ki. Laal ka 1/3 aur neeli ka 1/2: kiska hissa lamba hai, ya dono barabar?

director.text: ek jitne

Haan, bilkul theek. Laal ka 1/3 36 ÷ 3 = 12 cm, neeli ka 1/2 24 ÷ 2 = 12 cm, toh dono barabar. Achha, pehle wala sawaal phir se dekhte hain. Ek ribbon 60 cm ki hai aur doosri 30 cm ki. Rahul ne pehli ka 1/3 liya, aur Sana ne doosri ka 1/2. Dono ke hisson mein kitne cm ka fark hai?
director.card: Ek ribbon 60 cm ki hai aur doosri 30 cm ki. Rahul ne pehli ka 1/3 liya, aur Sana ne doosri ka 1/2. Dono ke hisson mein kitne cm ka fark hai?

director.text: Hindi mein bolo
Haan, Hindi mein batati hoon. 60 cm ki ribbon ka 1/3 kaata, aur 30 cm ki ribbon ka 1/2. Jo hissa lamba nikla, woh doosre se kitne cm lamba hai?
director.card: 60 cm ki ribbon ka 1/3 kaata, aur 30 cm ki ribbon ka 1/2. Jo hissa lamba nikla, woh doosre se kitne cm lamba hai?

director.text: Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 5 cm hai, kyunki Rahul ka hissa 60 ÷ 3 = 20 cm, Sana ka 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm; 20 − 15 = 5. Ab ek hi poore ko kabhi kam, kabhi zyada barabar hisson mein baantenge, aur dekhenge ki ek hissa kaise badalta hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
sixer

Oho, sixer! Isi mein tumhe maza aata hai. Ab apni padhai par lautte hain. Yeh do pattiyan bilkul ek jaisi hain. Pehli 3 barabar hisson mein bati hai, doosri 6 mein. 6 bada number hai, phir bhi 1/6 wala hissa 1/3 wale se chhota hai, kyunki wahi patti zyada hisson mein bati. Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?
director.card: Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?

director.text: do hisse

Haan, bilkul theek: har 1/3 jitni jagah mein do 1/6. Do ek hi size ki chocolate 2 aur 4 doston mein bati: 4 doston wala hissa chhota hai. Jitne zyada dost, har dost ka hissa utna chhota. Ab teen ek hi size ki chocolate 3, 10 aur 5 doston mein bati. Inke hisson mein sabse chhota kaunsa hai: 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5?
director.card: Ab teen ek hi size ki chocolate 3, 10 aur 5 doston mein bati. Inke hisson mein sabse chhota kaunsa hai: 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5?

director.text: ek bata das

Sahi jawab, kyunki 10 doston wala hissa sabse chhota, phir 5 wala, phir 3 wala, toh 1/10 sabse chhota. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum mil ke karenge. Ek patti barabar baantni hai. Hissa 1/3 se chhota par 1/6 se bada chahiye, aur dost 2, 4 ya 7 ho sakte hain. Dekhna hai patti kitne doston mein baantein. Har option ke liye pehle kya nikaaloge?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum mil ke karenge.

director.text: Haan, pehle har dost ka hissa, har option mein. Ab har hissa do baaton par jaanchna hai: woh 1/3 se chhota ho, aur 1/6 se bada. Tumhari baari: toh patti kitne doston mein baantoge, 2, 4 ya 7?
director.card: Tumhari baari: toh patti kitne doston mein baantoge, 2, 4 ya 7?

director.text: four

Haan, sahi hai. Do dost bahut kam hain aur saat bahut zyada; sirf chaar doston par hissa dono shartein poori karta hai. Toh poora jawab: patti 4 doston mein baanto; har dost ka hissa 1/4 hai. Ab agla sawaal tumhare liye. Ek cake ko barabar hisson mein kaatna hai, aur har hissa 1/6 cake se chhota chahiye. Kam se kam kitne hisse karne honge?
director.card: Ek cake ko barabar hisson mein kaatna hai, aur har hissa 1/6 cake se chhota chahiye. Kam se kam kitne hisse karne honge?

director.text: 5 sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Do ek jaisi roti: ek 2 logon mein bati, doosri 8 mein. 2 logon mein har ek ko aadhi roti milti hai, 8 mein bas ek patla sa hissa. Teen ek jitni dor 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati. Kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?
director.card: Teen ek jitni dor 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati. Kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?

seams.form: Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: Nahi, 1/4 theek nahi. 4 sabse chhota number hai, par 4 hisson wali dor par kainchi sabse kam baar chali, toh uske hisse sabse lambe hain, chhote nahi. 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati teen ek jitni dor mein se kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?
director.card: Teen ek jitni dor 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati. Kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?

director.text: 9 wali ka sabse chhota

Haan, bilkul theek: teeno dor ek jitni lambi hain, aur 9 wali sabse zyada hisson mein kati, isliye uska hissa, 1/9, sabse chhota. Theek hai, wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain. Ek cake ko barabar hisson mein kaatna hai, aur har hissa 1/6 cake se chhota chahiye. Kam se kam kitne hisse karne honge?
director.card: Ek cake ko barabar hisson mein kaatna hai, aur har hissa 1/6 cake se chhota chahiye. Kam se kam kitne hisse karne honge?

seams.form: Theek hai, wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain.

director.text: 5 se baat nahi bani. 5 hisse karne par har hissa 1/6 se bada ho jaata hai; ek hi cake ke kam hisse karo toh har hissa bada hota hai, chhota nahi. Har hissa 1/6 se chhota chahiye: cake ke kam se kam kitne barabar hisse karoge?
director.card: Ek cake ko barabar hisson mein kaatna hai, aur har hissa 1/6 cake se chhota chahiye. Kam se kam kitne hisse karne honge?

director.text: Sahi jawab, kyunki 6 hisse dete theek 1/6; chhota hissa 6 se zyada hisson par milta hai, aur sabse kam 7, yaani 1/7. Ek hi raste par cycle ne raste ka 1/6 hissa tay kiya, scooter ne 1/8, aur bus ne 1/7. Sabse zyada door kaun gaya: cycle, scooter ya bus?
director.card: Ek hi raste par cycle ne raste ka 1/6 hissa tay kiya, scooter ne 1/8, aur bus ne 1/7. Sabse zyada door kaun gaya: cycle, scooter ya bus?

director.text: the bicycle

Haan, sahi hai. Raasta ek hi hai, aur 6, 7, 8 mein 6 sabse chhoti ginti hai, toh 1/6 wala hissa sabse lamba. Zoya kehti hai ki 1/8 sabse bada hai, kyunki 8 sabse bada number hai. Asal mein 1/8, 1/5 ya 1/6 mein sabse bada kaunsa hai?
director.card: Zoya kehti hai ki 1/8 sabse bada hai, kyunki 8 sabse bada number hai. Asal mein 1/8, 1/5 ya 1/6 mein sabse bada kaunsa hai?

director.text: one fifth

Bilkul sahi: 1/5 mein poora sabse kam hisson mein bata hai, sirf 5 mein, toh 1/5 sabse bada; 1/8 sabse chhota. Ab ek se zyada cheezein barabar baantenge, jaise kuch roti kuch bachchon mein, aur har ek ka hissa bhinn mein likhenge. Yahan tak saaf hai?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh bhinn wala kaam khatam ho jaaye. Ab yeh kaam poora karte hain. 3 roti 4 bachchon mein barabar baantni hain. Har roti ke 4 barabar hisse karo, aur har bachche ko har roti se ek hissa do, yaani 1/4. Teen roti se teen hisse milte hain: 3/4 roti. Ab bachche wahi 4 hain, par roti sirf 2. Ek bachche ke hisse mein kitni roti aayegi?
director.card: Ab bachche wahi 4 hain, par roti sirf 2. Ek bachche ke hisse mein kitni roti aayegi?

seams.form: Ab yeh kaam poora karte hain.

director.text: 4/2 sahi nahi hai. Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain. 2 roti, 5 bachche: ek bachche ko har roti ka ek rangin hissa milta hai, toh 2 roti se 2 hisse; roti bachchon se kam hain, toh yeh ek poori roti se kam hai. 4 roti 7 bachchon mein barabar baanti gayi. Ek bachche ke paas kitni roti pahunchi?
director.card: 4 roti 7 bachchon mein barabar baanti gayi. Ek bachche ke paas kitni roti pahunchi?

seams.form: Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain.

director.text: 4/7 hai na
Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki har roti se 1/7, aur roti 4, toh 4/7; roti upar, bachche neeche. Cricket mein kya kabhi kuch barabar baantna padta hai?
bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
